systematic_findings.da29_10105j_assessment: DA29-10105J appears 8 times in the 15 target slugs and is not corroborated by ANY external source for ANY Samsung refrigerator model. It is very likely a phantom/erroneous part number throughout the repo. Recommend repo-wide audit of all DA29-10105J mappings.
systematic_findings.da29_00019a_assessment: DA29-00019A appears 5 times in these targets. It is a real Samsung filter (older round twist-in type) but is mapped to models that use the newer square push-in HAF-QIN housing. These are cross-generation mapping errors.
systematic_findings.rf28r6241_color_variant_note: RF28R6241 has 3 color variants in this batch (SB, SG, SW) — all use the same filter (HAF-QIN). Evidence is INFERRED for individual color variants because most sources list the base model only. The Samsung spec sheet for the parent RF28R6201SR family confirms HAF-QIN for this generation.
